sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232771 (public search API, 18 sites), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232771 (all 18 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 18 single-family sites, two accessible. Catalog max vehicle lengths 28-60 ft (most 35-50), all back-in; seven tagged riverfront on Rock Creek.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/greenough-lake-campground ('The campground offers 18 single-family campsites; two are accessible.') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232771 (Max Vehicle Length 28-60, Driveway Entry Back-in on all, Proximity to Water 'Riverfront' on 7), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand-pumped drinking water. Food storage lockers (bear country); firewood from the host; trash collection.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/greenough-lake-campground ('Accessible vault toilets and hand-pumped drinking water are provided', 'provided food storage lockers') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232771 (amenities 'Food Storage Locker', 'Firewood Vender', 'Trash Collection'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: '5/26 - 9/8 Weather Dependent.' recreation.gov: 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting.'

Concession-run by Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA). 15 sites reservable on recreation.gov (until 2 days before arrival), 3 first-come sites booked in person only. 16 consecutive nights.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232771 (catalog: 15 reservable, 3 not; notice 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 2) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/greenough-lake-campground ('Contact Name: Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA)'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF campground on the banks of the Main Fork of Rock Creek, just off the Beartooth Highway ~12 mi south of Red Lodge, under aspen and pine; Greenough Lake (canoe/kayak, trout) is 0.2 mi away. Hellroaring and Lake Fork trailheads nearby. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 18 sites, no electric, vault toilets/hand-pump water, reservable on recreation.gov ($20, 2026; fees left as recorded). Changed max_rig_ft 40 -> 60 (catalog, all back-in). Added season 05-26 to 09-08, some first-come sites, 16-night limit, RRMA concession. Not stated: water/sewer at sites (derived none left), booking window (left inherited). Note trimmed of restated values.

Missing phone: the concessionaire RRMA, (928) 537-8888 (Forest Service page and recreation.gov). Concession-run; 3 first-come sites.
